headline: The sync still has not run, so Wednesday's bike is unconfirmed rather than undone - and whether today's tempo block happens is a number on your watch, not in this file.
body:
Nothing has landed since **08:16 yesterday** - the newest activity in the file is still Tuesday's 2,020 m swim, so Wednesday could not have appeared either way. Did the **80 minutes, 2 x 18 min at 140-150 bpm**, and Push land?

Today is 10 km: 3 km easy, then **5 km at 150-158 bpm, 6:15-6:25/km** - three or four words at a time, not full sentences - then 2 km easy. Pull in the evening.

One gate, and you read it off the watch because I cannot. HRV came in at **60 then 48 against a 14-day mean of 61**, four Unbalanced mornings running, so the two-below rule has already fired. **61 or above this morning, run the block. Below it, all 10 km easy at 6:45-7:15/km under 145 bpm** and bank the tempo - Saturday's 85 km brick outranks a Thursday effort. Resting HR is still **45**, so this is a nervous-system flag, not illness.

Run the sync before Saturday. And the ankle, two days out?
